features.f: A tall, muscular big-cat woman who stands upright with no hunch and is leaner than the male: a slimmer lioness- or cheetah-like face with a shorter muzzle and small dark nose, larger rounded-triangle cat ears standing up on top of the head, and no chin or chest ruff. Fur covers the whole body (plain, tiger-striped or leopard-spotted, often with dark tear lines), with clawed hands, paw-like clawed feet, and a long thin tail ending in a dark tuft.
features.m: A huge, hulking big-cat man with very broad shoulders, a thick neck and a slight forward hunch: a wide lion-like head with a broad flat nose, short heavy muzzle and small fangs, small rounded ears set low on the sides of the head and half hidden in the mane, and a shaggy pale fur ruff on the chin and chest. Fur covers the whole body (plain lion, tiger-striped or leopard-spotted), with big clawed paw-like hands and feet, and a long thin lion tail ending in a dark tuft.

f.desc: A sleeveless, high-necked black vest of draped fabric with a green collar-mantle patterned in gold zigzags, gold piping, a silver tasselled pendant on the chest and a silver-trimmed slit showing a little waist, worn with a dark belt carrying two big black hip pouches studded with gold arrowheads and dangling gold-tipped cords. Green-and-gold zigzag rings on the upper arms, green-and-gold lattice vambraces over black fingerless gloves, black tights with round dark knee pads and lacing down the shins, and black open-toe strappy sandals with a silver medallion.

m.desc: A bare, furry chest crossed by one brown leather strap with a brass medallion clasp, a black fur-edged leather pauldron over one shoulder, and a dark laced leather girdle with two brown belts and brass buckles. Below, a short dark-grey pleated leather kilt with a maroon front flap bearing a silver emblem, big olive-grey leather pouches on the hips, wrapped black leather bracers on the forearms, and dark open-toe strappy sandals with thick grey-white fur cuffs around the shins.

notes: Hairs: XIVAPI CharaMakeType rows 24/25 (Helions m/f) and 26/27 (The Lost m/f), Gender 0 = male; the Hairstyle menu (Lobby 234) is identical for both clans, so there are no clan-only extras. Creator lists 45 male and 27 female styles, all CharaMakeCustomize IsPurchasable=false; the aesthetician sheet HairMakeType holds 90/60, and the extras are IsPurchasable=true Modern Aesthetics unlocks, so they are left out. Order is the creator's: feature ids 9,17,10,18 ... 16,24 are eight base manes each followed by a variant, then the shared styles (feature 101+ and 178). m11/m12 icons differ only by one stray lock (the variant may differ more from behind); whether the thin band across m20's forehead is a braid of hair or a cord is unclear. Icons show the front only, so backs (e.g. how long m38's tail is) are partly guessed. Skins: taken from the creator's 'Skin Color' menu (customize index 8), which colours the body fur; the creator interface palette from human.cmp via xivdyetools. The male and female palettes are identical; Helions offer warm browns, tawny, mustard gold, rose-brown and red, The Lost offer white, greys, blue-greys, lavender, sage and periwinkle-to-indigo. The 8 swatches mix both clans. The mane uses the separate 'Fur Color' menu (customize index 10, the hair-colour slot) = the key colour; in the creator icons the male chin/chest ruff matches the mane, but that is not verified in data. Attire: item names from the Race sheet (RSEM*/RSEF*), confirmed as the creator outfit because CharaMakeType Equipment set 0 equals their models (e0597 v1 male, e0829 v1 female); colours from official renders, undyed. Heights from the consolegameswiki Races table (0%/50%/100%), scale = 50% height / 90 cm.
